title: NFC normalisation
description: Restates QR Code Generation, 5. Step 4 — Serialise as CBOR; HCERT Specification, 3.2.7 Health Certificate Claim. QR Code Generation, 5. Step 4 — Serialise as CBOR: “Strings SHOULD be NFC-normalised. Decoders SHOULD be permissive about input that is not.”.

statements.label: NFC normalisation
statements.requirement: The encoder SHOULD NFC-normalise text strings. The decoder SHALL accept strings that are not normalised, and comparison helpers SHALL behave as if both sides were normalised to NFC.

successCriteria.criterion: A test named after STT-CBR-002 passes in each implementation's suite (Kotlin: `STT-CBR-002 text is NFC-normalised on encode, and a non-normalised string still decodes` (EncodeCborTest.kt)).
